definitions: Deceptive practices or schemes conducted over the internet to trick individuals into giving money or personal information.

Any type of fraud scheme that uses the internet to present false solicitations to prospective victims, to conduct fraudulent transactions, or to transmit the proceeds of fraud to financial institutions or to others connected with the scheme.
examples: Victims of online fraud often face significant financial losses.
Reporting online fraud is crucial for prevention.
The government launched a campaign against online fraud.
